capabilities: , Edit Markdown notes as mind maps
disambiguation: It structures notes using Markdown headings and lists, not as a free-form diagram tool.
extras: XMind import and export are one-off conversions and do not carry over styles or relationships.
intentEvidence: The idea of editing Markdown notes as mind maps in Obsidian was inspired by Enhancing Mindmap.
problem: Users often struggle to visualize the hierarchical structure of complex Markdown notes without switching to a separate diagramming tool.

relations.evidence: The idea of editing Markdown notes as mind maps in Obsidian was inspired by Enhancing Mindmap.

summary: Mapdown allows users to edit Markdown notes as synchronized mind maps, providing two views—text and visualization—within the same file.
